summary: Verified both promoted-child bugs. Bug 1 (parent-rename cascades to child's promoted_from_task_title) confirmed via pytest hitting live backend: parent rename -> child GET returns new title. Bug 2 (status-dot color reflects real overdue-aware bucket) fully verified in UI: created a parent + 4 promoted children (active/overdue/done/paused) and asserted the dot class + Turkish tooltip for each in the parent's 'BU GÖREVDEN ÇIKANLAR' section. All 4 dots match spec.

minor.issue: When client sends subtasks WITHOUT explicit `id`, the persisted subtasks lose their id in Mongo (Pydantic default_factory value is stripped via exclude_unset). Every subsequent read regenerates a fresh random id, breaking any client that cached the previously-returned sub id (e.g. calling POST /api/tasks/{tid}/subtasks/{sub_id}/promote with that id returns 404 'Alt görev bulunamadı'). Real UI works because it re-fetches then uses the freshly-generated id, but this is fragile. Recommend either (a) using `exclude_none` instead of `exclude_unset` for the subtasks field, or (b) explicitly filling missing ids server-side before update.

action_items: (Optional) Harden PATCH /api/tasks subtasks id persistence — see backend minor issue.
